checks: Relay info verifies contract code hash and vault, quotes buy/sell fees from live gas and BNB price
A second approval-gas request is refused once the wallet holds enough BNB for the approval
A zero-BNB wallet receives exactly enough BNB for one 70k-gas approval and approves the relay
No approval gas once the relay is already approved
A request changed after signing is refused before broadcast
Relayed buy: user receives the signed shares, pays at most budget + signed fee, executor gets exactly the fee, relay keeps nothing, fee covers gas
Replaying a used signature is refused (nonce)
A fee below the current gas quote is refused
Relayed sell: user gets at least the signed net minimum, executor gets exactly the fee, relay keeps nothing, fee covers gas
Approval gas is refused for wallets without USDT
Collected USDT fees are converted to BNB through PancakeSwap V2 with a V3-priced minimum
BNB above the 0.02 working float is returned to the treasury, keeping 0.01 for gas
A journal entry whose nonce is already used (a lagging RPC node) is dropped instead of blocking the relay
A transaction stuck past every signed deadline is replaced at the same nonce with a 25% higher gas price
